stem: The nurse _____ the patient's blood pressure every morning.
explanation_tr: Cevap 'checks' cunku ozne 'The nurse' ucuncu tekil sahis (he/she) ve cumlede 'every morning' gibi bir rutin/tekrar ifadesi var. Present Simple'da ucuncu tekil sahisa -s eklenir.
rule_tr: Present Simple: He/She/It + V-s/es (rutin, genel gercek, tekrar eden eylemler)
tip_tr: every day, always, usually, often gibi sikligi gosteren zarflar gorursen Present Simple dusun.
extra_example: The doctor always examines patients carefully. (Doktor hastalari her zaman dikkatli muayene eder.)

stem: Hospitals _____ emergency services 24 hours a day.
explanation_tr: Ozne 'Hospitals' cogul oldugu icin fiil ek almaz. '24 hours a day' ifadesi genel bir gercegi anlatiyor, bu yuzden Present Simple kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Simple: Cogul ozne (They/We/You/Hospitals) + V (yalın fiil, -s almaz)
tip_tr: Oznenin tekil mi cogul mu olduguna dikkat et. Cogul ozneler fiil eki almaz.
extra_example: Nurses work in shifts at this hospital. (Hemsireler bu hastanede vardiyali calisir.)

stem: The doctor _____ a patient right now, please wait.
explanation_tr: 'Right now' ifadesi su anda olan bir eylemi gosteriyor. Su anda devam eden eylemler icin Present Continuous (am/is/are + V-ing) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Continuous: am/is/are + V-ing (su anda olan eylemler)
tip_tr: now, right now, at the moment, currently gorursen Present Continuous dusun.
extra_example: The nurse is preparing the medication at the moment. (Hemsire su anda ilaci hazirliyor.)

stem: Look! The paramedics _____ the injured person into the ambulance.
explanation_tr: 'Look!' ifadesi su anda gozlerimizin onunde olan bir eyleme dikkat cekiyor. Bu yuzden Present Continuous kullanilir.
rule_tr: Look! / Listen! gibi ifadeler Present Continuous tetikler.
tip_tr: Look!, Listen!, Watch out! gibi uyari ifadeleri su anda olan eylemi isaret eder.
extra_example: Listen! The baby is crying in the ward. (Dinle! Bebek koguslta agliyor.)

stem: The surgeon _____ the operation successfully yesterday.
explanation_tr: 'Yesterday' belirli bir gecmis zaman ifadesidir. Belirli gecmis zaman icin Past Simple (V2) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Past Simple: S + V2 (yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020 gibi belirli gecmis zaman zarflariyla)
tip_tr: yesterday, last week, ago, in + yil gorursen Past Simple kullan.
extra_example: The patient recovered from the surgery two weeks ago. (Hasta iki hafta once ameliyattan iyilesti.)

stem: The patient _____ any medication before the appointment last Monday.
explanation_tr: 'Last Monday' gecmis zamani gosteriyor. Past Simple'in olumsuz hali 'did not (didn't) + yalin fiil' seklindedir.
rule_tr: Past Simple olumsuz: S + didn't + V1 (yalin fiil)
tip_tr: Past Simple olumsuzda fiil V1 (yalin) kalir, -ed ALMAZ. didn't zaten gecmisi gosterir.
extra_example: The doctor didn't prescribe antibiotics for a cold. (Doktor soguk alginligi icin antibiyotik yazmadi.)

stem: The doctor _____ you the test results tomorrow.
explanation_tr: 'Tomorrow' gelecek zamani isaret ediyor. Gelecekte olacak eylemler icin 'will + V1' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Future Simple: S + will + V1 (tomorrow, next week, in the future)
tip_tr: tomorrow, next, soon, in the future gorursen will + V1 dusun.
extra_example: The hospital will open a new ward next month. (Hastane gelecek ay yeni bir kogus acacak.)

stem: She has an appointment at 3 PM. She _____ the dentist this afternoon.
explanation_tr: Randevusu var, yani onceden planlanmis bir eylem. Onceden planlanmis gelecek eylemler icin 'be going to + V1' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Going to: S + am/is/are + going to + V1 (onceden planlanmis eylemler)
tip_tr: Plan veya niyet varsa 'going to', anlik karar ise 'will' kullan.
extra_example: I am going to start a new treatment next week. (Gelecek hafta yeni bir tedaviye baslayacagim — planli.)

stem: The patient _____ three pills since this morning.
explanation_tr: 'Since this morning' ifadesi gecmiste baslayip su ana kadar devam eden bir durumu gosteriyor. Bu tip ifadeler icin Present Perfect (have/has + V3) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Perfect: S + have/has + V3 (since, for, already, yet, just, ever, never ile)
tip_tr: since (belirli zaman) ve for (sure) gorursen Present Perfect dusun.
extra_example: She has worked as a nurse for ten years. (On yildir hemsire olarak calisiyor.)

stem: I _____ never _____ such a serious allergic reaction before.
explanation_tr: Ozne 'I' oldugu icin 'have' kullanilir (has degil). 'Never' ve 'before' Present Perfect isaretcileridir. V3 formu 'seen' dogru.
rule_tr: I/You/We/They + have + V3 | He/She/It + has + V3
tip_tr: never, ever, before, already, yet, just — bu kelimeler Present Perfect'in en onemli isaretcileridir.
extra_example: Have you ever donated blood before? (Daha once hic kan bagisi yaptin mi?)

stem: The nurse _____ the patient's wound when the doctor arrived.
explanation_tr: Doktor geldiginde (arrived — Past Simple) hemsire yarayi temizliyordu (devam eden eylem). Gecmiste devam eden bir eylem baska bir eylemle kesildiginde, devam eden eylem Past Continuous olur.
rule_tr: Past Continuous + when + Past Simple: Devam eden eylem kesilir. was/were + V-ing
tip_tr: when + Past Simple gorursen, diger cumlede Past Continuous olabilir (devam eden eylem icin).
extra_example: The patient was sleeping when the alarm went off. (Alarm caldiginda hasta uyuyordu.)

stem: While the surgeon _____ the operation, the power suddenly went out.
explanation_tr: 'While' devam eden bir eylemi gosterir. Cerrah ameliyat yaparken (devam eden — Past Continuous), elektrik kesildi (ani — Past Simple).
rule_tr: While + Past Continuous, Past Simple: while = devam eden eylem, ani olay = Past Simple
tip_tr: while gorursen Past Continuous dusun; when gorursen genelde Past Simple gelir.
extra_example: While I was waiting at the pharmacy, I met an old friend. (Eczanede beklerken eski bir arkadasa rastladim.)

stem: The doctor _____ patients since 8 o'clock this morning without a break.
explanation_tr: 'Since 8 o'clock' gecmiste baslayan ve su anda hala devam eden bir eylemi gosteriyor. Eylemin surekliligi ve devam ettigi vurgulandiginda Present Perfect Continuous kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Continuous: S + have/has + been + V-ing (gecmiste baslayip hala devam eden eylem, surec vurgusu)
tip_tr: since/for + eylem hala devam ediyorsa VE sureci vurguluyorsan Present Perfect Continuous kullan.
extra_example: She has been studying medicine for six years. (Alti yildir tip okuyor — hala devam ediyor.)

stem: You look tired. _____ you _____ all night at the hospital?
explanation_tr: 'You look tired' su andaki gorunumu tarif ediyor. Yakin gecmiste yapilan ve etkisi su anda gorulen bir eylem icin Present Perfect Continuous uygundur.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Continuous soru: Have/Has + S + been + V-ing?
tip_tr: Birinin yorgun, mutlu, uzgun gorunmesi gibi su anki durumu aciklayan bir gecmis eylem icin Present Perfect Continuous dusun.
extra_example: He has been coughing all day. That's why his throat is sore. (Butun gun oksuruyordu. Bu yuzden bogazi agriyor.)

stem: The patient _____ already _____ the medication before the doctor changed the prescription.
explanation_tr: Iki gecmis eylem var: 1) ilaci almak, 2) doktorun receteyi degistirmesi. Once olan eylem (ilaci almak) Past Perfect, sonra olan (receteyi degistirmek) Past Simple olur.
rule_tr: Past Perfect: S + had + V3 (gecmiste iki olaydan ONCE olan icin)
tip_tr: before, after, by the time, already gorursen ve iki gecmis eylem varsa, once olani had + V3 yap.
extra_example: By the time the ambulance arrived, the nurse had already given first aid. (Ambulans geldiginde hemsire coktan ilk yardim yapmisti.)

stem: The surgeon realized that she _____ the wrong instruments for the procedure.
explanation_tr: Cerrah fark etti (realized — Past Simple). Yanlis aletleri hazirlama eylemi fark etmeden ONCE oldu, bu yuzden had prepared (Past Perfect) kullanilir.
rule_tr: realized/discovered/noticed + that + had + V3: Fark etme aninda onceki eylem Past Perfect olur.
tip_tr: realized, noticed, discovered gibi fiillerden sonra gelen yan cumlede genellikle Past Perfect bulunur.
extra_example: The lab discovered that they had mixed up the blood samples. (Laboratuvar kan orneklerini karistirmis olduklarini fark etti.)

stem: Don't worry. The treatment _____ any side effects, I promise.
explanation_tr: 'Don't worry' ve 'I promise' ifadeleri gelecek hakkinda bir guvence veriyor. Soz verme, guvence gibi anlik kararlar ve vaatler icin 'will' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Will kullanim: soz/vaat (I promise), anlik karar, tahmin, guvence
tip_tr: I promise, I think, Don't worry gibi ifadelerle gelecekten bahsediliyorsa will kullan.
extra_example: I will call you as soon as the test results are ready. (Test sonuclari hazir olur olmaz seni ararım.)

stem: The hospital administration _____ a new emergency unit next year. The plans are ready.
explanation_tr: 'The plans are ready' planlarin hazir oldugunu gosteriyor. Onceden planlanmis ve hazirlik yapilmis gelecek eylemler icin 'be going to' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Going to: onceden planlanmis + kanit/hazirlik varsa | Will: anlik karar, tahmin, soz
tip_tr: Plan/hazirlik kaniti varsa going to, yoksa will. 'The plans are ready' = going to.
extra_example: She is going to have surgery next Friday. Everything is arranged. (Gelecek cuma ameliyat olacak. Her sey ayarlandi.)

stem: The number of COVID patients _____ significantly since the vaccination campaign started.
explanation_tr: 'Since the vaccination campaign started' ifadesi gecmiste baslayan ve su ana etkisi olan bir durumu gosteriyor. Since ile Present Perfect kullanilir.
rule_tr: since + gecmis zaman noktasi = Present Perfect (has/have + V3)
tip_tr: since her zaman Present Perfect ile eslesir. for ise hem Present Perfect hem Past Simple ile kullanilabilir.
extra_example: Medical technology has advanced enormously since the 1990s. (Tip teknolojisi 1990'lardan beri muazzam ilerledi.)

stem: While I _____ for my appointment, I _____ an interesting article about heart disease.
explanation_tr: While + Past Continuous (devam eden eylem) + Past Simple (araya giren/tamamlanan eylem). Beklerken makaleyi okudum.
rule_tr: While + Past Continuous, Past Simple: uzun eylem while ile, kisa/tamamlanan eylem Past Simple ile
tip_tr: Iki gecmis eylem varsa: uzun sureni was/were + V-ing yap, kisasini V2 yap.
extra_example: While the nurse was checking vitals, the patient suddenly fainted. (Hemsire hayati bulgulari kontrol ederken hasta aniden bayildi.)

stem: Research _____ that regular exercise _____ the risk of cardiovascular disease.
explanation_tr: Bilimsel gercekler ve genel gecerli bilgiler Present Simple ile ifade edilir. Arastirma gosteriyor (genel gercek) ve egzersiz riski azaltir (bilimsel gercek) — ikisi de Present Simple.
rule_tr: Bilimsel gercekler, genel dogru bilgiler = Present Simple (zaman zarfi olmasa bile)
tip_tr: Bilimsel makale dili: 'Research shows that X reduces/causes/improves...' seklinde Present Simple kullanilir.
extra_example: Studies confirm that smoking causes lung cancer. (Calismalar sigara icmenin akciger kanserine neden oldugunu dogruluyor.)

stem: The pharmaceutical company _____ several clinical trials so far, but none of them _____ conclusive results.
explanation_tr: 'So far' Present Perfect isaretcisidir. Birinci ozne 'company' (tekil — has), ikinci ozne 'none of them' (cogul anlam — have) kullanilir.
rule_tr: so far, up to now, until now = Present Perfect | none of them + have (cogul muamele gorur)
tip_tr: none of + cogul isim = cogul fiil alir (none of them have). Company = tekil (has).
extra_example: None of the treatments have shown significant improvement so far. (Tedavilerin hicbiri su ana kadar belirgin iyilesme gostermedi.)

stem: If the patient _____ the symptoms earlier, the disease could have been treated more effectively.
explanation_tr: 'Could have been treated' gecmiste gerceklesmeyen bir olasilik (Third Conditional yapisi). If clause'da Past Perfect (had + V3) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would/could have + V3 (gecmiste gerceklesmeyen durum)
tip_tr: could have been / would have been gorursen, if clause'da had + V3 olmali.
extra_example: If the ambulance had arrived sooner, the patient would have survived. (Ambulans daha erken gelseydi hasta hayatta kalirdi.)

stem: Researchers at the university _____ on a new vaccine for over three years, and they expect to announce results soon.
explanation_tr: 'For over three years' sureci gosteriyor ve 'they expect to announce results soon' eylemin hala devam ettigini gosteriyor. Devam eden surec vurgusu icin Present Perfect Continuous kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Continuous vs Present Perfect: surec/devam vurgusu = Continuous | sonuc/tamamlanma vurgusu = Simple
tip_tr: for + sure + hala devam ediyor + surec vurgusu = have/has been V-ing
extra_example: Scientists have been researching this virus since 2020. (Bilim insanlari 2020'den beri bu virusu arastiriyor.)

stem: By the time the specialist _____, the patient _____ for three hours in the emergency room.
explanation_tr: 'By the time + Past Simple' yapisinda, diger cumlede Past Perfect veya Past Perfect Continuous kullanilir. Hasta 3 saat bekliyordu (surec) — Past Perfect Continuous.
rule_tr: By the time + Past Simple, Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing) = gecmisteki bir noktaya kadar devam eden surec
tip_tr: By the time = o zamana kadar. Sonrasinda gelen cumlede had + V3 veya had been + V-ing bekle.
extra_example: By the time the results came, we had been waiting anxiously for two days. (Sonuclar geldiginde iki gundur endiseyle bekliyorduk.)

stem: The hospital _____ its protocols since the pandemic started, and now it _____ one of the safest facilities in the region.
explanation_tr: 'Since the pandemic started' Present Perfect gerektirir (has updated). 'Now it _____ one of the safest' su anki durumu anlatir — Present Simple (is).
rule_tr: since + Present Perfect (gecmisten su ana) | now + Present Simple (su anki durum)
tip_tr: Bir cumlede birden fazla zaman olabilir. Her clause'un kendi zaman isaretcisine bak.
extra_example: She has lost 10 kg since she started the diet, and now she feels much healthier. (Diyete basladigindan beri 10 kg verdi, simdi cok daha saglikli hissediyor.)

stem: According to the WHO report, antibiotic resistance _____ one of the greatest threats to global health by 2050.
explanation_tr: 'By 2050' gelecek zaman ifadesidir. Gelecekteki bir olasilik/tahmin icin 'will + V1' kullanilir.
rule_tr: by + gelecek tarih = Future Simple (will + V1) veya Future Perfect (will have + V3)
tip_tr: by 2050, by next year gibi ifadeler gelecegi isaret eder. Basit tahmin = will + V1.
extra_example: Telemedicine will become more common in the next decade. (Teletip onumuzdeki on yilda daha yaygin hale gelecek.)

stem: At 3 AM, the on-call doctor _____ a critical patient, the nurses _____ medications, and the cleaners _____ the corridors.

options.text: was treating / were preparing / were mopping
is treating / are preparing / are mopping
had treated / had prepared / had mopped

explanation_tr: 'At 3 AM' gecmiste belirli bir anda devam eden eylemleri gosteriyor. Uc eylem de ayni anda devam ediyordu — hepsi Past Continuous.
rule_tr: At + belirli gecmis zaman = Past Continuous (o anda devam eden eylemler)
tip_tr: At 3 AM, at that moment, at midnight gibi ifadeler gecmiste belirli bir ani isaret eder — Past Continuous kullan.
extra_example: At midnight, the emergency team was performing surgery on two patients simultaneously. (Gece yarisi acil ekibi ayni anda iki hastaya ameliyat yapiyordu.)

stem: The doctor told the patient that he _____ to reduce his sugar intake if he _____ to avoid diabetes.
explanation_tr: 'Told' (Past Simple) dolayli anlatim (reported speech) baslatiyor. Direct speech'te 'need/want' olan fiiller reported speech'te bir zaman geri gider: needed/wanted.
rule_tr: Reported Speech: told + that + tense shift (Present → Past). needs → needed, wants → wanted
tip_tr: said/told/explained + that gorursen tum zamanlar bir kademe geri kayar (backshift).
extra_example: The pharmacist said that the medication was available in generic form. (Eczaci ilacin jenerik formda mevcut oldugunu soyledi.)

stem: Once the clinical trial _____, the pharmaceutical company _____ the drug for public use.
explanation_tr: 'Once' (bir kez ... oldugunda) zaman baglaci oldugu icin, gelecekten bahsedilse bile once'den sonra Present Simple veya Present Passive kullanilir. Ana cumlede ise will + V1 kullanilir.
rule_tr: Time clauses (once, when, after, before, as soon as) + Present tense, main clause + will + V1
tip_tr: once/when/after/before/as soon as + ASLA will kullanilmaz. Bu baglaclarda Present tense kullan, will ana cumlede kalir.
extra_example: As soon as the doctor finishes the examination, she will write the prescription. (Doktor muayeneyi bitirir bitirmez receteyi yazacak.)
